LanguageData.Omens_Settings_RainRevealsDesc: In rain, splashes outline an invisible hostile creature standing under open sky; in snow, white dust does. It stays untargetable. Requires Anomaly to matter.
LanguageData.Omens_Settings_CrowsDesc: Crows circle over raiders who wait before attacking, fly off toward your colony when the assault starts, and circle over the unburied dead after a bloody battle.
LanguageData.Omens_Settings_ColdCampDesc: Raiders who waited before attacking leave a cold campfire that remembers who camped there, how long, how many came and how many went home.
